note: Mostly seasonal: about 23 of its 104 sites are sold by the night (9 15-amp, 7 30-amp, 5 non-serviced hillside and 2 lakefront 30-amp); the rest are seasonal. Regional park on the north shore of Kipabiskau Lake, 29.5 km S of Tisdale on Hwy 35 then 11.7 km W, with a sandy beach, boat launch and marina, store, cabin rentals and about 10 km of trails; ATV and snowmobile trails reach the park. --Claude
summary: Keep with the seasonal caveat (reviewer check). Accredited regional park: 81 seasonal + 23 daily sites = 104; nightly share 22% (10-50% band). Posted nightly rates C$22.50-40, entry C$9/day; Google 4.7 (48). Booking by phone/email (gatehouse 306-873-5625). Not waterfront kept: the daily loops sit ~150 m inland behind the cabin row; two 'Lake Front' 30-amp daily sites exist but their location is unpublished. Sites count 23 -> 104.
flags: NIGHTLY SHARE: 23 of 104 sites daily (22%): '81 seasonal sites, 9 – 15 amp daily sites, 7 – 30 amp daily sites, 5 non-serviced hillside daily sites, 2 lakefront 30 amp daily sites'. Daily, weekly and monthly rates are posted for every daily class; no wording discourages nightly guests. Google 4.7 stars (48 reviews). The park also holds a leased cabin subdivision ('Cabin Holders' pay education tax) - cabins, not RV lots.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept (stored, not --AWH). Esri z16 (spring image): the main RV loops around 52.5745,-104.1945 are 120-180 m from the shore behind the lakeshore cabin row; the hillside loop (~52.5770,-104.1960) is farther. The SRPA fee table sells '30 Amp and Water – Lake Front' (2 daily sites, C$40), but no site map or numbers are published and the imagery cannot single them out; if the reviewer can locate them (phone 306-873-5625), the few-sites rule could make this lakefront with a caveat naming them.

OHV: SRPA amenities list 'ATV Trails' and snowmobile trails reach the park - a general lake campground with trail access, not a staging camp; stays.
